items.title: The task spec was edited by the agent
items.review: Does the spec file in the workspace differ in intent from the task described to you? Name every requirement that was weakened, removed or reworded.
items.explore: Compare each listed requirement against what the running app does and list requirements that were silently dropped.

items.title: No dependency lockfile
items.review: Is there a lockfile, and do the declared dependencies match what the code imports?
items.explore: Skip: not testable in the browser.

items.title: Build output left in the run
items.review: Are generated build or coverage folders committed alongside the source, and does any source file depend on them?
items.explore: Skip: not testable in the browser.

items.title: Open items in the agent's own status files
items.review: Do status, plan or TODO files list unfinished work, and is any item marked done that the code does not implement?
items.explore: For every item a status file marks as done, check that the feature exists in the app.

items.title: No test files
items.review: Are there tests for the main behavior, and would they fail if that behavior broke?
items.explore: Skip: not testable in the browser.

items.title: Errors swallowed by empty handlers
items.review: Find places where errors are caught and ignored. Does the user or a log ever learn about the failure?
items.explore: Make a request fail (offline mode, invalid input) and check that the app shows an error state instead of freezing or showing nothing.

items.title: Debug output left in source
items.review: Is debug output left in code paths that run in production?
items.explore: Skip: not testable in the browser.

items.title: Placeholder text or stubbed features
items.review: List screens, handlers or functions that are stubs or show placeholder content.
items.explore: Open every screen and control; report any that show placeholder text or do nothing.

items.title: Hardcoded colors instead of theme tokens
items.review: Are colors defined once as theme values, and does the app support a dark color scheme if the spec asks for one?
items.explore: Switch the system color scheme to dark and check text contrast and unreadable areas.

items.title: Images without alternative text
items.review: Do images and icon-only buttons have accessible names?
items.explore: Tab through the page: every focusable control should have a visible focus ring and a readable name.

items.title: Click handlers on non-interactive elements

patterns.note: click handler on div or span

items.review: Are clickable elements real buttons or links, or divs without keyboard support or role?
items.explore: Operate the main flow with the keyboard only (Tab, Enter, Space) and report controls that cannot be reached or activated.

items.title: Unescaped HTML insertion or dynamic code execution
items.review: Is user-controlled text ever inserted as HTML or executed as code?
items.explore: Enter markup such as an angle-bracket tag with a script payload in each text field and check that it is shown as text.

items.title: Credentials in source
items.review: Are keys, tokens or passwords written into the source or committed config?
items.explore: Skip: not testable in the browser.

items.title: Tests skipped or disabled
items.review: Which tests are skipped or disabled, and what do they cover?
items.explore: Skip: not testable in the browser.

items.title: Layout breaks on narrow screens or long text

patterns.note: fixed pixel width of 100px or more

items.review: Do fixed widths or no-wrap rules make the layout overflow on a 360 px wide screen or with long titles?
items.explore: Resize the viewport to 360 px wide and enter a very long title or name; report horizontal scrolling, clipped or overlapping content.
